sloka: विभीषणो ऽयं सम्प्रप्तो यं दृष्ट्वा वानरर्षभाः ।विद्रवन्ति परित्रस्ता रावणात्मजशङ्कया ।। ६.५०.९ ।।।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇo 'yaṁ samprapto yaṁ dṛṣṭvā vānararṣabhāḥ ।vidravanti paritrastā rāvaṇātmajaśaṅkayā ।। 6.50.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "Vibheeshana has come here. Beholding him the foremost of the Vanaras fleeing suspecting him to be the son of Ravana."
